body:
Kinematic bodies are not affected by gravity / damping (at least they're not in Jolt). I don't think we need to call `_update_environmental_properties` here?

Edit: I see that it is possible for users to fetch this value through `PhysicsBody3D::get_gravity`, so I guess for that case it is needed to call this. This is a bit of a waste and also incorrect as the body is not experiencing gravity. It is consistent with GodotPhysics3D though, which seems to call `GodotBody3D::integrate_forces` on every active body (including kinematic ones). We could consider setting `total_gravity = Vector3()` as soon as a body is made kinematic and stop updating it (maybe for another day).

Is it correct to remove this for these 4 setters? I think we need to call `_update_environmental_properties` here. E.g. when outside of any area and setting `linear_damp`, nothing will call `_update_environmental_properties` to update `total_linear_damp`, so to me it looks like this setter is broken now.

> We could consider setting total_gravity = Vector3() as soon as a body is made kinematic and stop updating it (maybe for another day).

The default `CharacterBody3D` script template calls `get_gravity`, so this is not an option currently.

`get_gravity` is however broken in multiple ways (see [here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/84640#issuecomment-1927117203) and [here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/112656#issuecomment-3553204312)) due to relying on `PhysicsDirectBodyState3D`, especially for kinematic bodies.

I guess `get_gravity` could also just calculate the total gravity itself as-needed, by iterating over its overlapping areas, but the bodies themselves don't actually know about their area overlaps on the scene side of things, so that would need to be introduced first.

Either way, that's a battle for another day. I would say point gravity is probably a pretty niche feature, so for most projects you now won't be updating gravity/damping for kinematic bodies at every simulation step (unlike before).

Nice catch. That is indeed broken. It made more sense before I pushed the last commit, but now not so much.

I will fix.
